_about: Invented for the Familiar demo: this paper does not exist and no parish issued it. It shows the shape of a home paper read literally.
title: Certificate of baptism of Helena, 1925

source.description: One printed sheet of the parish of the Holy Ghost, Quarry Bend, filled in by hand in ink; folded in four, torn along the vertical fold.
source.invented: Invented for the demo. There is no scan: a demo paper is shown only as its reading.

fields.Printed heading: Church of the Holy Ghost, Quarry Bend - Certificate of Baptism
fields.Father: Amaro Ferrolho, nat. de Lajedo do Vento
fields.Mother: Rosa Calhau, nat. de Ponta d[...]

reading: Church of the Holy Ghost, Quarry Bend - Certificate of Baptism. Helena, born April 2 1925, baptized April 19 1925. Father: Amaro Ferrolho, nat. de Lajedo do Vento. Mother: Rosa Calhau, nat. de Ponta d[...]. Sponsors: Manuel Tavares e Concei[?]ão Tavares. Rev. A. Sardinha. May 1 1925.

doubt.text: After 'Ponta d' the paper is torn along the fold; about six or seven letters are lost. Nothing after the tear is read.
The cedilla in 'Conceição' is a blot; the name is clear from the rest of the word.
